description: This file defines the Attribute model class for the OpenCart admin system, managing CRUD operations for attribute groups and attributes within the catalog module. It handles database interactions for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving attribute and attribute group data, including descriptions and filtering.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing product attribute groups and individual attributes within the OpenCart catalog module. Includes methods for CRUD operations, description management, and data filtering.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Creates a new attribute group in the database, including descriptions and associated attributes.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute group and its descriptions, attributes.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Deletes an attribute group and its related descriptions and attributes.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute group record by its ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attribute groups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute group records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for an attribute group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a specific attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute group descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given attribute group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all attribute group descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute within a specified attribute group, including descriptions.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a single attribute record by its ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attributes with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Counts total attributes matching optional filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Counts total attributes within a specific attribute group.

methods.name: addAttributeDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specified attribute.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute descriptions in a specified language.

methods.name: getAttributeDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific attribute description for a given attribute and language.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for an attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute descriptions in a specific language.
